data.name: Unseen
data.detailed_description:
Unseen – Darkness Within the Mind

Unseen is a dark, atmospheric visual novel that immerses the player in a surreal psychological horror experience. You awaken in a silent room. You don't know who you are, where you are, or why you’re here. But you’ve been here before — you can feel it.

In the depths of your forgotten past lies more than just memory. Regret, fear, and something... watching.

Story

Each scene represents a distorted reflection of your subconscious. As you uncover memories and piece together your identity, you are faced with choices that shape your fate. But beware — some truths are buried for a reason.

Gameplay Features

  • Classic visual novel structure

  • Choice-driven narrative

  • Quantum Fate System: Outcomes are not just random. Decisions, dice rolls, and events are shaped by quantum-inspired mechanics — superposition, entanglement, and collapse of possibilities. Characters and events may become mysteriously entangled, their destinies unraveling together.

  • Multiple endings (good, tragic, twisted)

  • High replayability (scenes shift based on your decisions)

Average Playtime

An average playthrough takes around 1 to 1.5 hours, but different paths can lead to vastly different endings.

Sound & Atmosphere

Unseen creates horror through atmosphere, not action. With haunting soundscapes, echoing whispers, and melancholic piano melodies, the game draws players into a claustrophobic psychological maze.

Why Play Unseen?

Unlike traditional horror games, Unseen explores fear through introspection and uncertainty.
Here, horror is not found in monsters, but in your decisions, memories, and regrets.
With eldritch tones, psychological collapse, and the eerie weight of quantum uncertainty, Unseen offers a uniquely haunting experience.

data.short_description: A story-driven visual novel set within the dark corridors of the mind. Uncover your past through choices, shape your fate with dice. Unseen blends psychological horror and eldritch atmosphere into a haunting narrative full of forgotten memories and buried fears.
